reply_text: Tobias, the site is **Southgate**. In the #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread from the 3 Sep 2025 outage, Priyanka wrote that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later in the same thread she noted that Southgate cleared the backlog and labels were printing again. The thread names only "Southgate," so if the customer call needs a full address or depot code, I'd check that with Pree or Hollis.
